name: Tabs
description: Navigation tabs for switching between related content panes. Implements YAMI Primary Style A/B, Secondary, and Tertiary variants from the YAMI UI UX Guidelines Tabs node, with default and inverse surfaces plus ARIA tab behavior.

figma.notes: Tabs source node `↪ 选项卡 Tabs`. Figma splits Mobile and WEB component sets and splits Primary Style A/B into separate sets. Code keeps one compound component with variant/styleVariant/inverse props and responsive CSS. Icon slots exist in WEB button components but are disabled in the reference examples; code exposes leftIcon/rightIcon for product use with real YAMI SVG assets.
figma.sizeDelta: Maintained web horizontal Primary Style A uses 56px triggers and 16/20 text on both mobile and PC. Code-side vertical Primary A uses 44px rows with the same text size; vertical Primary A and Secondary use 4px item gaps. Primary Style B uses a 52px segmented surface with a 44px trigger; its selected pill is 32px below 1024px and 36px from the 1024px desktop breakpoint. Secondary stays underline-based at 40px with 14/20 text on both mobile and PC. Tertiary aligns its visual, layout, and hit-target heights: 32px below 1024px and 36px from the desktop breakpoint.
figma.stateMapping: Figma State=Default/Skeleton maps to TabsList skeleton=false/true. Selected/default tab states map to data-state='active'/'inactive'. Hover/focus are code-only interaction states; disabled is a code-side accessibility state for product use.

notes: Use TabsList as the direct trigger container and TabsTrigger for each tab option.
Use TabsContent when tab panels differ. Match every TabsTrigger value to a TabsContent value.
Do not replace triggers with plain buttons or custom spans.

defaultValue.description: Initial selected tab value for uncontrolled use. Without it, panels stay hidden until activation and only the first enabled trigger is tabbable.

onValueChange.description: Called when an enabled tab is activated by click, Enter/Space, or automatic arrow-key activation.

activationMode.description: automatic changes selection while arrowing; manual only moves focus until click/Enter/Space.

TabsList.styleVariant.description: Primary-only visual axis from Figma. styleVariant='a' is underline; styleVariant='b' is segmented.

TabsList.inverse.description: Use inverse colors for the active theme's opposite-polarity surface.

TabsList.fullWidth.description: Stretch the list and distribute triggers evenly.

TabsList.centerActiveTab.description: Reveal controlled selection updates inside the list, respecting reduced motion and scroll boundaries.

TabsList.align.description: Center items when they fit; overflow retains start alignment.

TabsList.skeletonCount.description: Number of non-interactive placeholders while skeleton is true.

TabsTrigger.value.description: Unique, case-sensitive value that links the trigger to its panel; localized values and punctuation retain distinct IDs.

TabsTrigger.controls.description: Existing external content ID; defaults to the matching TabsContent panel ID. The consumer owns external content semantics.

TabsTrigger.leftIcon.description: Optional icon before label. Use currentColor SVGs from packages/design-system/assets/icons.

TabsTrigger.rightIcon.description: Optional icon after label. Use currentColor SVGs from packages/design-system/assets/icons.

levels.note: Primary for major content groups, Secondary for sub-sections, Tertiary for compact category filters. Do not mix levels in the same list.

focus.note: 2px solid --focus-ring ring with --focus-ring-inverse on opposite-polarity surfaces. Use a 2px inset in scrolling lists without gutters; Primary B outlines the visible capsule pseudo-element at a 2px outer offset, independently of the 44px hit area.

tapTarget.note: Web targets preserve geometry: Primary A 56px, Primary B 44px, Secondary 40px, Tertiary 32px below 1024px and 36px on desktop. Compact variants have no invisible extensions and do not claim the native iOS 44pt / Android 48dp minimum.

disabled.note: Disabled tabs use --text-disabled / --text-disabled-inverse and are skipped by arrow-key navigation.

icons.note: When icon slots are used, pass currentColor SVGs from packages/design-system/assets/icons; do not use ad-hoc glyphs.

accessibility.disabled: Disabled triggers set aria-disabled=true, tabIndex=-1, and are skipped by arrow navigation.
accessibility.labelling: Require aria-label or aria-labelledby on each TabsList. Trigger and panel IDs use useId + losslessly encoded value; controls may reference an existing external content region.
accessibility.focusManagement: One enabled roving Tab stop; manual activation moves focus without selection until Enter/Space or click.
accessibility.targetGeometry: Web: Primary A 56px horizontal / 44px vertical, Primary B 44px, Secondary 40px, Tertiary 32px mobile / 36px desktop. Compact targets do not claim native minimum dimensions.
